note: P is mostly one image written three times: a lens-shaped cloud over a ridge with wind running through it while the cloud stays still (P1, P2, P4), with only P3's pearl veil at dusk differing. Q is one subject, nacreous cloud, in every poem, but its angles differ more: Q1 is the sun lighting it from below the horizon, Q4 is its brief vanishing before it gets a name, while Q2 and Q3 are nearly the same winter-dusk glow.
